title: AGENTS.md — Guidance for AI Agents
text: Language, naming, comments, commit messages English . Use roxygen2 (e.g. #' @param, @return) documentation. Follow tidyverse style: 2-space indent, spaces around operators. Functions variable names snake_case.

title: AGENTS.md — Guidance for AI Agents
text: Prioritise clarity readability cleverness. Use pure functions clearly defined inputs outputs possible. Follow Single Responsibility Principle — function one thing. Avoid code duplication — use helper functions factor repeated logic. Use early returns reduce indentation nesting. Avoid deeply nested logic long functions; split logic modular components. Document every exported function consistent roxygen tags. Use @export public functions .

title: AGENTS.md — Guidance for AI Agents
text: package uses testthat unit testing: Mirror function names tests/testthat/test-*.R. Use test_that(“description”, { … }) blocks. Prefer multiple small, readable expectations. Mock external data randomness needed repeatability.

title: Severe Incidence and Mortality
text: original Griffin-2016 calculations hard-wired shortcut refactor severe cases mortality, malaria deaths simply taken 0.215 times modelled incidence hospital‑treated severe case. replaced explicit two‑stream calculation first separates severe episodes hospital community compartments, applies setting‑specific case‑fatality ratios stream. new column, ft_sev, lets users supply (vary time) proportion severe cases reach hospital. warning‑backed default 0.8 preserves backward compatibility - default used original 0.215 (based default parameterisation) deaths‑‑hospitalised‑cases ratio recovered.

code: my_function <- function(data, var, ...) {   data %>%     group_by(...) %>%     summarise(mean = mean({{ var }})) } my_function <- function(data, var, ...) {   # Defuse   var <- enquo(var)   dots <- enquos(...)    # Inject   data %>%     group_by(!!!dots) %>%     summarise(mean = mean(!!var)) } my_var <- "disp" mtcars %>% summarise(mean = mean(.data[[my_var]])) my_function <- function(data, var, suffix = "foo") {   # Use `{{` to tunnel function arguments and the usual glue   # operator `{` to interpolate plain strings.   data %>%     summarise("{{ var }}_mean_{suffix}" := mean({{ var }})) } my_function <- function(data, var, suffix = "foo") {   var <- enquo(var)   prefix <- as_label(var)   data %>%     summarise("{prefix}_mean_{suffix}" := mean(!!var)) }
